Blocks.Text: This migration is complete. This page is left for reference purposes only.

LinkedIn is making changes to a selection of our permissions to better serve our members and partners. This document serves as a guide for migration from LinkedIn’s old to new permissions. This guide is created for those with LinkedIn Marketing Solutions permissions only. This guide may not be relevant to all partners based on the program they belong to.
If you have an existing integration, these changes will not immediately impact you. We will reach out at a later date to help guide your migration for existing integrations.
